# npm-cache

npm's download cache. npm downloads packages again when needed.

**Name:** npm cache · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/commands/npm-cache>

**Detected when** one of `npm` is on PATH or one of `{npm_cache}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{npm_cache}`: `npm config get cache` → `$npm_config_cache` → macOS `~/.npm/_cacache` → Linux `~/.npm/_cacache` → Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%/npm-cache/_cacache` (command and env results get `/_cacache` appended)

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{npm_cache}` | npm download cache | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `native:npm-cache-clean`, `quarantine` |

## Native commands

- `native:npm-cache-clean` runs `npm cache clean --force` (timeout 300 s, freed space measured before and after)
